_comment: Gate misra enforces the documented MISRA C:2012 subset only: 10.x (essential type model / implicit conversions), 11.x (pointer conversions), 15.x (control flow: goto, single exit), 17.7 (unused return values), 21.3 (no malloc/free), 21.6 (no stdio), 21.8 (no abort/exit/getenv) and 21.21 (no system; cppcheck 2.10 checks system() under 21.21, not 21.8). Every other rule is suppressed through --suppress-rules above. Justified exceptions to the subset go to scripts/cppcheck-suppressions.txt with a reason. scripts/misra_canary/canary.c must trip 21.3, 21.6, 21.8 and 21.21 before the real scan runs.
